references.name: ios-sweet
references.role: Initial iOS 16-era XNU and userland reference
references.reuse: Research methods and subsystem decomposition only

references.name: ios-sunstone
references.role: Later-stage XNU 8796 plus iPhone X 20H392 userland reference
references.hardware: Redmi Note 12 5G, Qualcomm SM4375 / Snapdragon 4 Gen 1
references.reported_milestone: SpringBoard with touch, keys, display, battery and eight CPU cores
references.reuse: Architecture, build reproducibility, patch ordering, diagnostics and subsystem checklist

references.name: ios-qemu
references.role: Virtualized iPhone X 20H392 userland and XNU 8796 compatibility reference
references.hardware: QEMU virt machine with emulated devices on Apple Silicon
references.reported_milestone: iOS 16.7.16 (20H392) userland, launchd, SpringBoard, Settings and Safari
references.reuse: Userland dependency research, XNU patch categorization, build reproducibility and subsystem boundaries
reported_limitations: No microphone, camera, Bluetooth, cellular, location or Face ID
Experimental security model with permissive code-signing and sandbox behavior

references.name: ios-sailfish
references.role: Later-stage iOS 16.7.16 (20H392) userland and XNU 8796 reference on Pixel 1
references.reported_milestone: Upstream README reports lock screen, touch, buttons, Wi-Fi and GPU acceleration
references.reuse: Component boundaries, persistent diagnostics, per-subsystem status and porting process only
reported_limitations: No Bluetooth, cellular, audio, camera, sensors, GPS, Touch ID or SEP
Pixel-specific drivers and board values are not portable to A10

references.name: ios-alioth
references.role: Work-in-progress per-board XNU 8796 port status reference
references.hardware: POCO F3 / Qualcomm SM8250; source lineage also includes SM7150 and Xiaomi Mi 10
references.reported_milestone: README says alioth reaches iOS lock screen; touch is listed as next step
references.reuse: Per-board status discipline and separation of shared kernel work from board-specific data
reported_limitations: README says much of detailed tested table applies to sweet, not alioth
Qualcomm-specific hardware data is not portable to A10

project_target.note: The iPhone X userland reference and other-device results do not establish iPhone7 platform or UI compatibility.
